changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE public.ingestion_execution ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS retry_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE public.ingestion_execution ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS max_retries integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE public.ingestion_execution ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS next_retry_at timestamp
ALTER TABLE public.ingestion_execution ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS retry_exhausted boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
ALTER TABLE public.ingestion_execution ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS parent_execution_id bigint

DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ingestion_execution' AND column_name = 'retry_attempt' ) THEN UPDATE public.ingestion_execution SET retry_count = COALESCE(retry_attempt, 0) WHERE retry_count = 0 AND retry_attempt IS NOT NULL; END IF; END $$;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_exec_next_retry ON public.ingestion_execution (next_retry_at, status, retry_exhausted)
